summary: The AI model repository and deployment platform ecosystem in 2026 is dominated by Hugging Face, which hosts over 2.2 million models and 2.2 billion cumulative downloads, making it the default hub for open-weight AI. A growing set of specialized inference and deployment platforms such as Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, Ollama, and AWS Bedrock complement Hugging Face by offering optimized serving infrastructure, serverless GPU compute, and enterprise-grade scalability. A small concentration of model families drives the majority of usage, with Qwen, Gemma, and Llama leading download charts as of September 2026.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: Central open-source hub for sharing, discovering, and running machine learning models, datasets, and demos across virtually every AI domain
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public repositories; Pro plan at $9/month; Enterprise Hub from $20/user/month; Inference Endpoints billed per compute hour
features: 2.2 billion+ cumulative model downloads as of late 2025
Hosts Spaces for interactive ML demos and apps
Inference API for serverless model calls
Dedicated Inference Endpoints for private deployments
Dataset and model versioning with Git-based system
Top model families include Qwen (240.1M monthly downloads), Gemma (32.6M), and Llama (12.9M) as of September 2026
Supports fine-tuning, AutoTrain, and evaluation leaderboards
Private and enterprise-grade access controls
platforms.best_for: Researchers, open-source developers, and enterprises looking to discover, share, or fine-tune open-weight models in a collaborative environment

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: Local-first tool for downloading and running large language models entirely on personal hardware without cloud dependencies
platforms.model_count: 500+ supported models including Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Mistral, and DeepSeek variants
platforms.pricing: Completely free and open-source; costs limited to local hardware
features: One-command model pull and run on macOS, Linux, and Windows
OpenAI-compatible local API for easy integration
Offline and air-gapped operation with no data leaving the device
Supports GPU acceleration on Apple Silicon, NVIDIA, and AMD
Modelfile system for custom model configuration and system prompts
Active GitHub repository ranked among top AI repositories in 2026
Integrates with Open WebUI for a self-hosted ChatGPT-like interface
Multimodal model support including vision models
platforms.best_for: Privacy-conscious developers, hobbyists, and enterprises needing fully local LLM inference with no cloud costs or data exposure

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: Cloud platform for running open-source machine learning models via a simple pay-per-second API without managing infrastructure
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second billing based on GPU type used; no upfront costs; free tier available for experimentation
features: Simplest API integration path among major inference platforms
Supports image, video, audio, text, and multimodal models
One-click model deployment with auto-scaling
Cog framework for packaging custom models into containers
Webhooks and async predictions for production workflows
Fine-tuning support for select models including SDXL and Llama
Community model sharing and discovery
OpenAI-compatible endpoints for some models
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups who want the fastest path to running diverse open-source models in production without DevOps overhead

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: High-performance, low-cost LLM inference and fine-tuning cloud platform with an OpenAI-compatible API focused on open-weight models
platforms.model_count: 100+ leading open-source models including Llama, Qwen, Mistral, DeepSeek, and Gemma variants
platforms.pricing: Per-token pricing with some of the lowest rates in the industry; fine-tuning billed per token processed; free $1 credit on signup
features: OpenAI-compatible API for drop-in replacement
Lowest-cost LLM inference among major cloud inference providers as of 2026
Dedicated endpoints for consistent latency
Full fine-tuning and inference pipeline on proprietary data
Retrieval-augmented generation support
Batch inference for high-volume workloads at reduced cost
Safety and moderation tools built in
SOC 2 Type II compliance for enterprise customers
platforms.best_for: Cost-sensitive developers, AI startups, and enterprises needing high-throughput open-model inference with fine-tuning capabilities at scale

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: Ultra-fast inference platform for open-source LLMs and generative AI models optimized for production-grade speed and reliability
platforms.model_count: 50+ curated production-ready models with support for custom model uploads
platforms.pricing: Per-token and per-second pricing depending on model; competitive rates with a free tier for prototyping; volume discounts available
features: Industry-leading inference speed with proprietary FireAttention optimization engine
OpenAI-compatible API for seamless migration
Function calling and JSON mode for structured outputs
Supports text, image, and embedding models
Custom model deployment with dedicated GPU capacity
Compound AI system support for multi-model pipelines
SOC 2 compliance and enterprise SLAs
Real-time streaming with low time-to-first-token latency
platforms.best_for: Production AI applications requiring the fastest possible inference latency on open-weight models, particularly for customer-facing real-time use cases

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.purpose: Fully managed AWS service for accessing and deploying foundation models from multiple leading AI providers within the AWS cloud ecosystem
platforms.model_count: 50+ foundation models from providers including Anthropic, Meta, Mistral, Stability AI, Amazon, and Cohere
platforms.pricing: On-demand per-token pricing per model; Provisioned Throughput for consistent capacity billed hourly; model customization billed per token during training
features: Single API to access models from multiple providers including Claude, Llama, Mistral, and Amazon Titan
Native AWS IAM integration for enterprise security and compliance
Agents for Bedrock enabling multi-step agentic workflows
Knowledge Bases for RAG with native vector store integration
Model fine-tuning and continued pre-training on proprietary data
Guardrails for content filtering and responsible AI policies
VPC support and private endpoints for data residency requirements
Fully serverless with no infrastructure management required
platforms.best_for: Enterprises already invested in the AWS ecosystem that need secure, compliant, and scalable access to multiple foundation models with deep cloud service integrations
